title: Penang Makan Trip
subtitle: Street art, hawker feasts & sunset jetties in George Town

activities.name: Land at Penang Airport
activities.note: Grab to George Town takes about 30 min (~RM30).

activities.name: Nasi kandar at Line Clear
activities.note: Ask for 'banjir' — all the curries poured over your rice.

activities.name: Street art hunt on Armenian Street
activities.note: Find 'Kids on Bicycle' and the other murals. Go before 3pm, it gets hot.

activities.name: Sunset at Chew Jetty
activities.note: Wooden stilt village over the sea — golden hour is magic.

activities.name: Gurney Drive Hawker Centre
activities.note: Char kway teow, oyster omelette, pasembur. Share lots of small plates!

activities.name: Funicular up Penang Hill
activities.note: Go early on a weekday to skip the queue. Cooler up top!

activities.name: Air Itam Assam Laksa
activities.note: Sour, spicy fish broth — Penang's most famous bowl.

activities.name: Kek Lok Si Temple
activities.note: Climb the pagoda and take the lift to the giant Guan Yin statue.

activities.name: Penang Road famous cendol
activities.note: Shaved ice, coconut milk, gula Melaka. Perfect for the heat.

activities.name: Chulia Street night hawkers
activities.note: Wonton mee and satay. Stalls open around 6pm.

activities.name: Penang National Park & Monkey Beach
activities.note: Hike in, boat back (~RM60 per boat, share it). Bring water.

activities.name: Entopia butterfly farm
activities.note: Indoor and outdoor gardens — great on a rainy afternoon too.

activities.name: Fly home
activities.note: Leave Batu Ferringhi by 5pm — traffic can be slow.

tips: Use the Grab app for rides — cheap and easy everywhere on the island.
Hot and humid with sudden rain: light clothes and a small umbrella.
Many hawker stalls close one day a week — check before you go.
Cover shoulders and knees when visiting temples and mosques.
Carry small cash; most hawkers don't take cards.
